I'm good, let's keep going. Can you give me a short Apps Script that (assuming headers in row 1 and data from row 2 on a sheet named "Raw" and helper columns G:P already filled) will:
- mark SUPERSEDED for older submissions per email (keep the most recent),
- ensure any row with G/H/I/J = "REVIEW" gets P="REVIEW",
- copy all rows where P="OK" and O="" into (and overwrite) a sheet named "Final" as values only,
and otherwise make no deletions? Keep it simple so I can paste it into Tools > Script editor.

Nice — a couple tweaks before I paste it in:

Can you update the script so it:
- detects how many columns there actually are (use the full header length, not fixed 16),
- keeps the P column formulas intact (only write "REVIEW" into P when the current cell is empty — but still ensure any row with G/H/I/J = "REVIEW" will end up marked, i.e., fill P only where blank),
- still marks SUPERSEDED by email (most recent kept),
- also marks SUPERSEDED for rows without email when nameKey matches and timestamps are within a configurable window (e.g., 10 minutes) — keep a variable at top like const TIME_WINDOW_MIN = 10,
- otherwise make no deletions and still overwrite Final with values only.

Make it simple so I can paste and run. Use 1-based column names in comments so I can map them easily.

Nice — this is almost perfect. Two tweaks before I paste:

1) Can you simplify the P-fill so it does batch writes (faster) instead of setting each cell inside a loop, and only writes into P where the cell has neither a formula nor a value?  
2) Make the script not bail if lastCol < 16 — instead ensure we read/write at least through column 16 (extend ranges/arrays with blank values if needed), since my sheet sometimes has fewer exported cols but still uses G:P helpers.

Otherwise keep everything else the same (TIME_WINDOW_MIN at top, name+time clustering, preserve formulas).

Nice — one more tweak before I paste: can you add a tiny run log and make TIME_WINDOW_MIN optionally prompted?

Specifically:
- At the top keep `const TIME_WINDOW_MIN = 10;` but if the script is run interactively, prompt me with `SpreadsheetApp.getUi().prompt(...)` to confirm or change the value (use the constant as the default). If the prompt is cancelled, keep the constant.
- After finishing, append a row to a sheet named "Logs" (create it if missing) with: run timestamp, total rows processed, number superseded, number exported to Final, and the TIME_WINDOW_MIN used.

Keep everything else the same (batch P writes, padding to 16 cols, name+time clustering). Short and paste-ready.

Great — two small additions before I paste:

1) Can you add the runner email (use Session.getActiveUser().getEmail(), but fall back to blank if unavailable) to the Logs row?  
2) Also log counts for (a) number of rows newly marked SUPERSEDED by this run (not total with that text) and (b) number of P cells newly written to "REVIEW" (i.e., were blank before and now set).  

Keep everything else the same.
